response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY ordertune), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM type_counts), above_avg_types AS (SELECT tc.order_count, (tc.order_count - oa.avg_count) as excess FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE tc.order_count > oa.avg_count) SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_of_above_avg_counts, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg_types
